_comment: Mi'yar — CEFR grammar syllabus. Per-level ordered grammar points (week, cefr, title, EN/AR explanation, examples), authored against public English Grammar Profile A1 concepts. One point per week; the week file references it by week number.

A1.title: Verb 'to be' + subject pronouns
A1.en: Use am / is / are with I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Make simple statements and yes/no questions about identity and origin.
A1.ar: استخدام am / is / are مع الضمائر. جمل بسيطة وأسئلة نعم/لا عن الهوية والأصل.

A1.title: Possessive adjectives + 'have got'
A1.en: my, your, his, her, our, their. Talk about family and belongings with have got / has got.
A1.ar: صفات الملكية (my, your, his...) والكلام عن العائلة والممتلكات بـ have got.

A1.title: Numbers, 'there is/are' + time prepositions (at/in/on)
A1.en: Cardinal numbers, there is / there are for existence, and at/in/on for times and days.
A1.ar: الأرقام، there is/are للوجود، وحروف الوقت at/in/on.
examples: There are seven days in a week.
The class is at three o'clock.

A1.title: Place prepositions + 'this/that/these/those'
A1.en: in, on, under, next to, behind, between; and demonstratives this/that/these/those.
A1.ar: حروف المكان (in, on, under...) وأسماء الإشارة this/that/these/those.
examples: The book is on the table.

A1.title: Present simple (I/you/we/they)
A1.en: Everyday routines and habits with the base verb for I/you/we/they, plus negatives with don't.
A1.ar: المضارع البسيط للروتين اليومي مع I/you/we/they، والنفي بـ don't.

A1.title: Present simple (he/she/it) -s + some/any
A1.en: Third-person -s, questions with does, and some/any with countable/uncountable food words.
A1.ar: إضافة -s للغائب المفرد، أسئلة بـ does، و some/any مع الأكل.

A1.title: 'How much / how many' + shopping language
A1.en: Ask about price and quantity: how much is…?, how many…?, I'd like…, and prices/money.
A1.ar: السؤال عن السعر والكمية: how much/how many، I'd like، والأسعار.

A1.title: Adjectives + describing people and things
A1.en: Common adjectives before nouns and after 'be'; question words what/who/where/how.
A1.ar: الصفات قبل الأسماء وبعد be؛ وأدوات السؤال what/who/where/how.

A1.title: 'can/can't' (ability) + like/love + -ing
A1.en: Express ability with can/can't and preferences with like/love/hate + verb-ing.
A1.ar: التعبير عن القدرة بـ can/can't والتفضيلات بـ like/love + الفعل+ing.

A1.title: Past of 'to be' (was/were) + review
A1.en: Talk about the past with was/were; consolidate all A1 grammar in short personal accounts.
A1.ar: الكلام عن الماضي بـ was/were؛ ومراجعة كل قواعد A1 في جمل شخصية قصيرة.
